title: N-able Issues Fourth N-central Hotfix in Five Weeks for Unauthenticated RCE Flaw
summary: Every on-premises N-central build below 2026.3.1.14 — including servers updated to Hotfix 3 a day earlier — needs Hotfix 4. N-able's incident notice says the flaw has been exploited in the wild; its release notes say that is unconfirmed.
